overview_description.description: Lendflow develops a lending infrastructure platform built to change and improve the way businesses access capital. They allow a user to embed financial products into their software to increase engagement, improve retention, and become a source of capital for their business users. They also provide term loans, lines of credit, and invoice factoring to cover businesses of all sizes and credit risks, enabling construction, home services companies, e-commerce, restaurants, transportation, and fitness businesses to connect their users with capital and increase the reach of their businesses.

about_short_description.short_description: Lendflow is a fintech platform that enables lending, connecting businesses to lenders with tools for loan, credit decision, and automation.

product.name: Embedded Application or Native API
product.description: A unified API or white-labeled code that enables platforms to offer customers access to various financial products for business funding needs.

product.name: Private Marketplace
product.description: A platform that routes business lending applications to one or multiple lenders using data-driven waterfall logic to match customers with suitable lending products.

product.name: Online Checkout
product.description: A native online checkout system that pre-fills stipulations, collects documents, integrates fraud tools, and enables electronic signing for loan applications.

product.name: AI Credit Modeling and Targeting
product.description: A platform leveraging multiple credit datasets and fraud toolsets to enable cost-efficient pre-qualification and credit decisioning for lending.

product.name: AI Communication Automation
product.description: An omni-channel communication system powered by artificial intelligence to engage applicants and customers and support sales efficiency.

product.name: Automated Loan Placement
product.description: A system that uses rules or predictive modeling to match borrowers with appropriate lenders using scorecards and lender criteria.
